text:
Priya C.: urgent escalation from CS — AcmeCorp's private deployment (acme-prod, eu-west-1) has been unreachable since ~08:12 UTC after partner DX maintenance. API endpoints time out (504s) and console shows connection errors. They report DX flapped and we expected IPsec fallback but traffic isn't routing. Can oncall/network please take?

SRE Oncall Bot: incident created: INC-2026-0417-42. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ipsec-fallback. Assigned: oncall-net + eng-infra.

Tom N.: ping — do we know BGP/IKE status? if DX flapped and BGP died, IPsec should've come up. Common causes: blocked IKE UDP 500/4500, cert validation failing (OCSP/CRL) if customer uses cert auth.

Ben K.: grabbing logs from the edge while issue started, posting trimmed output:
```
Apr 17 08:12:09 ipsec[12345]: IKEv2: initiating IKE_SA to 198.51.100.2
Apr 17 08:12:10 ipsec[12345]: IKEv2: cert_verify_failure: OCSP request timed out
Apr 17 08:12:10 ipsec[12345]: child_sa: cannot create, no valid peer certificate
Apr 17 08:12:12 bgpd[2345]: BGP session to 10.255.0.1: NOT_ESTABLISHED (no route to peer)
```

Alice M.: that log screams OCSP/DNS or egress block. Ask customer: can they confirm outbound allowlist/egress ACLs? Need to allow DNS to their resolver and OCSP endpoints for their CA, plus UDP 500/4500 for IKE. Also helpful: run `sudo tcpdump -n -i eth0 'udp port 53 or port 80 or port 443 or port 500 or port 4500'` and `sudo ipsec statusall`.

Maria E.: partner's maintenance doc showed they applied a strict egress ACL on edge devices during the window (deny-by-default for internet egress). That would block OCSP/CRL and also DNS to 8.8.8.8 etc. BGP might look up but child SA won't form if cert verification can't check revocation status. So we get no installed routes.

Ben K.: ran tcpdump per Alice — results: no outbound UDP to known OCSP hosts, DNS queries for `ocsp.acme-ca.example` are failing with SERVFAIL. Snippet:
```
08:12:09.123456 IP 10.0.0.5.49152 > 8.8.8.8.53: 12345+ A? ocsp.acme-ca.example. (37)
08:12:09.124000 IP 10.0.0.5.49152 > 198.51.100.2.4500: UDP, length 200 (no reply)
```

Tom N.: can network team temporarily open outbound to: ocsp.acme-ca.example (TCP/HTTP) and allow DNS (UDP 53) to their resolver + allow UDP 500/4500 to peer 198.51.100.2? If yes, we'll re-initiate the tunnel: `sudo ipsec restart && sudo ipsec up acme-prod-tunnel` and watch `ipsec statusall` and `vtysh`/`show bgp`.

SRE Oncall Bot: action assigned to Tom N. (network) and Ben K. (infra). ETA 15m.

Tom N.: network team confirmed they opened the ACLs to allow OCSP and DNS, and permitted UDP 500/4500 to the peer. Re-initiating IKE now.

Ben K.: executed: `sudo ipsec up acme-prod-tunnel` -> seeing IKE_SA established and child SA created. BGP now receives routes and installs prefixes. Sample after fix:
```
Apr 17 08:22:46 ipsec[12345]: IKEv2: IKE_SA established with 198.51.100.2
Apr 17 08:22:47 ipsec[12345]: CHILD_SA acme-prod established
Apr 17 08:22:50 bgpd[2345]: BGP session to 10.255.0.1: ESTABLISHED
```

SRE Oncall Bot: incident update: connectivity restored at 08:22 UTC. Monitoring checks green.

Priya C.: root cause confirmed with customer: partner maintenance applied deny-by-default egress ACL on their on-prem appliance that blocked DNS/OCSP and IKE UDP ports. That prevented cert revocation checks and IKE handshake during DX->IPsec failover. No config changes on Redwood side. Customer satisfied with fix.

Alice M.: postmortem action items: 1) update Private/VPC peering runbook to list required egress allowlist (DNS to customer resolver, OCSP/CRL endpoints for customer CA, UDP 500/4500 to peer IPs, outbound HTTPS for CA OCSP if used). 2) add a pre-check script to onboarding to validate these egress rules. 3) add an alert for long-lived IPsec SA age + immediate SA negotiation failures (cert verify errors) to surface earlier.

Maria E.: also recommend we add a small note in CS onboarding checklist to confirm partner/third-party maintenance windows and that they won't apply deny-by-default egress during handoffs.

Priya C.: thanks all — I'll file RFC and assign owners for the runbook changes. :thumbsup:

Tom N.: :thumbsup:

Ben K.: closing thread from infra side, will follow up with runbook PR tomorrow.

SRE Oncall Bot: incident INC-2026-0417-42 resolved and closed.
